## Scalability benchmark
```{r}

library(ggthemes)
method.colors.corr <- c(colorblind_pal()(3))[c(2,3)]



bench.mc <- read.table('../../../benchmark/10xMultiomeProstateHan22/Integrating_metacells_RNA_ATAC_prostateCancer.txt',header = T)

bench.sc <- read.table('../../../benchmark/10xMultiomeProstateHan22/single_cell/RNA_object_construction.txt',header = T)
bench.sc <- rbind(bench.sc,read.table('../../../benchmark/10xMultiomeProstateHan22/single_cell/ATAC_object_construction.txt',header = T))

bench.sc <- rbind(bench.sc,read.table('../../../benchmark/10xMultiomeProstateHan22/single_cell/ATAC_RNA_integration.txt',header = T))

bench.sc.final <- data.frame(cpu_time = sum(bench.sc$cpu_time),
                             memory = max(bench.sc$max_rss),
                             workflow = "single-cells")

bench.mc.final <- data.frame(cpu_time = sum(bench.mc$cpu_time),
                             memory = max(bench.mc$max_rss),
                             workflow = "metacells")

bench.final = rbind(bench.sc.final,bench.mc.final)
bench.final$workflow <- factor(bench.final$workflow,levels = c("single-cells","metacells"))
bench.final$memory <- bench.final$memory/1000

p1 <- ggplot(data = bench.final,aes(x = workflow,y = cpu_time,fill = workflow)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + ylab("CPU time (s)") + scale_fill_manual(values = method.colors.corr) + NoLegend()

p2 <- ggplot(data = bench.final,aes(x = workflow,y = memory,fill = workflow)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + ylab("Memory (GB)") + scale_fill_manual(values = method.colors.corr)+ NoLegend()

ggplot(data = bench.final,aes(x = workflow,y = cpu_time,fill = workflow)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + ylab("CPU time (s)") + scale_fill_manual(values = method.colors.corr)
```
```{r fig.height=2,fig.width=3.25}
dir.create("plots")
ressource.plot.prostate <- list("A" = p1, "B" =p2)
ressource.plot.prostate

saveRDS(ressource.plot.prostate,'plots/ressource.plot.prostate.rds')
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
#combined.metacells$major_type <- droplevels(combined.metacells$major_type)
smpCounts <- aggregate(combined.metacells$size, by=list(sample = combined.metacells$sample,
                                                        major_type = combined.metacells$major_type,
                                                        celltype = combined.metacells$celltype,
                                                        time = combined.metacells$time), FUN=sum)
ggplot(smpCounts,aes(x=sample,y = x,fill = time)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity")  +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) + ylab("sc counts")
```


```{r fig.height=3,fig.width=3.5}

library(colorspace)
darker_colors <- darken(colors, 0.2)
names(darker_colors) <- names(colors)
contingencyTable <- xtabs(x ~ major_type+time,data = smpCounts)
colSums(contingencyTable)

freqMatrix <- apply(contingencyTable,1,FUN = function(x){x/colSums(contingencyTable)})
# res <- chisq.test(contingencyTable)
# Roe <- res$observed/res$expected

freqMatrix_df <- melt(freqMatrix)

freqMatrix_df$major_type <- factor(freqMatrix_df$major_type ,
                                   levels = c("Basal","Endothelial","Luminal","Neuroendocrine","B_cell","T_cell","Macrophage","Neutrophil","Seminal_vesicle","Mesenchymal_1","Mesenchymal_2","Neuron"))

freqMatrix_df$group <- freqMatrix_df$major_type

#freqMatrix_df$group[freqMatrix_df$time == "WT"] <- NA

prop.mean.all <- ggplot(freqMatrix_df,aes(x = time,y=value*100,color=major_type,group = group)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + facet_wrap("~major_type") +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) + theme_bw() + scale_color_manual(values = darker_colors) + ylab("% total cells (mean of samples)") + NoLegend()

prop.mean.all
```
```{r}
freqMatrix_df$category <- "Other cells"
freqMatrix_df$category[freqMatrix_df$major_type %in% c("Neutrophil","Macrophage","T_cell",'B_cell')] <- "Immune cells"
freqMatrix_df$category[freqMatrix_df$major_type %in% c("Basal","Neuroendocrine",  "Luminal")] <- "Prostate Cancer cells"
#freqMatrix_df$group[freqMatrix_df$time == "WT"] <- NA
freqMatrix_df$category <- factor(freqMatrix_df$category,

plot.prop.all

saveRDS(plot.prop.all,"plots/plot.prop.prostate.all.rds")
```

#uncorrected data
```{r fig.width=7,fig.height=2.75}
DefaultAssay(combined.metacells) <- "RNA"
combined.metacells <- FindVariableFeatures(combined.metacells) %>% ScaleData() %>% RunPCA(reduction.name = "uncorrected_pca") %>% RunUMAP(reduction ="uncorrected_pca",reduction.name = "uncorrected_rna_umap",dims = 1:50)

combined.metacells <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(combined.metacells, reduction.list = list("uncorrected_pca", "lsi"), dims.list = list(1:50, 2:50),weighted.nn.name = "uncorrected.weighted.nn")
combined.metacells <- RunUMAP(combined.metacells, nn.name = "uncorrected.weighted.nn", reduction.name = "uncorrected_wnn.umap", reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_")

p1 <- DimPlot(combined.metacells,reduction = "uncorrected_wnn.umap",group.by = c("sample","celltype"),cols = my36colors)
p2 <- DimPlot(combined.metacells,reduction = "wnn.umap",group.by =  c("sample","celltype"),cols = my36colors)

p1 
p2
```

```{r fig.height=2,fig.width=4.5}
DefaultAssay(combined.metacells) <- "ATAC"
genes <- c("Krt8","Chga","Krt5","Svs5","Col1a2","Cdh5","S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19","Plp1")
combined.metacells@meta.data$major_type <- factor(combined.metacells$major_type,                                                
                                                  levels = c("Luminal","Neuroendocrine","Basal",
                                                             "Seminal_vesicle","Mesenchymal","Endothelial",
                                                             "Neutrophil","Macrophage",
                                                             "T_cell","B_cell","Neuron"))

#genes <- c("S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19")

TSS <- GetTSSPositions(Annotation(combined.metacells))
TSS <- TSS[TSS$gene_name%in% genes,]

regions <- lapply(X = genes, function(X){
  TSSgene <- TSS[TSS$gene_name == X]
  region <- Extend(TSSgene,upstream = 100,downstream = 100)
  return(region)
  })

regions

p <- CoveragePlot(
    object = combined.metacells,
    region = regions,ncol = length(TSS),
    peaks = FALSE,color = colors,
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = colors) 

p$patches$plots[[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[1]]  & theme(
                             axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                             #axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                             axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) & xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[1]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))

for (i in c(2:length(TSS))) {
  p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),strip.background = element_blank())  & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                             strip.background = element_blank(),
                             axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                             axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                             axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
 

}

p
```

```{r fig.height=2,fig.width=5}

Idents(combined.metacells) <- combined.metacells@meta.data$major_type 
  
genes <- c("Krt8","Chga","Krt5","Svs5","Col1a2","Cdh5","S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19","Plp1")

genes <- c("S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19")

TSS <- GetTSSPositions(Annotation(combined.metacells))
TSS <- TSS[TSS$gene_name%in% genes,]

regions <- lapply(X = genes, function(X){
  TSSgene <- TSS[TSS$gene_name == X]
  region <- Extend(TSSgene,upstream = 500,downstream = 100)
  return(region)
  })

regions

p <- CoveragePlot(
    object = combined.metacells,
    region = regions,ncol = length(TSS),
    peaks = F,color = colors, 
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = colors) 

for (i in c(2:length(TSS))) {
  p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),strip.background = element_blank())

}


p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                             strip.background = element_blank(),
                             title = element_blank(),
                             axis.text.x = element_blank())

p
```
